summary: All 22 audit findings (C-1 through L-4) and the ecommerce_api dev-mode auth bypass are fully implemented and verified. Row locks follow with_for_update() consistently across transfer_manager, stock_take_service, supplier_return_service, and waste routes. Decimal casts are applied uniformly in all 7 affected call sites. Both schema migrations are idempotent (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guard + column-type check for the NUMERIC migration; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS for the functional index). Session rollback guards are in place for supplier_return_service, sales_manager (customer upsert and audit log), and online_orders. The IdempotencyKey.consume TOCTOU race is closed with an IntegrityError catch-and-requery pattern. The ecommerce_api bypass now requires current_app.testing to be True rather than defaulting open on missing config. All 17 modified Python files compile cleanly. One dead-code artifact (two unreachable rollback() lines after a return in the diff preview of sales/routes.py) was investigated and confirmed to be a diff display artifact — the actual source is correct. No new bugs introduced.
